identity.title: The kiloparsec-scale gas kinematics in two star-forming galaxies at z ∼ 1.47 seen with ALMA and VLT-SINFONI
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new ALMA Cycle-5 observations tracing the CO(2-1) emission line from two ‘typical’ star-forming galaxies at $z\sim1.47$.

question.value: How do the kpc-scale CO(2-1) molecular gas kinematics compare with H-alpha ionised gas in two main-sequence galaxies at z~1.47, and what do they imply for dynamical mass, dark matter fraction and depletion time?

evidence.quote: We carried out a follow-up study to resolve, at $\sim$kpc-scales, the CO emission.

method.value: tclean multiscale with Briggs weighting; high-res, 2000 kλ tapered and 0.5'' smoothed versions

evidence.quote: we set the spectral channel width to 25 km s$^{-1}$

method.value: CO luminosity, r21=0.85, alpha_CO from Accurso+17 and Narayanan+12

evidence.quote: We then estimate the CO(1-0) luminosity for each galaxy by assuming a $L'_{\rm CO(2-1)}/L'_{\rm CO(1-0)} = 0.85$ ratio

validation.value: alpha_CO upper limit from dynamics (Appendix B)

method.value: spatial binning to beam, chi2 Gaussian line fitting for intensity, velocity and dispersion

evidence.quote: we spatially bin the ALMA data-cube up to a scale given by the synthesized beam and then we perform an emission line fitting approach using a $\chi^2$ minimization procedure

method.value: 2D Sersic fit to CO moment 0 giving axis ratio ~0.90±0.05, inclination ~26±6 deg, error inflated to 10%

evidence.quote: We obtain an observed minor-to-major axis ratio of $\sim 0.90\pm 0.05$, which corresponds to an inclination angle value of $\sim26 \pm 6$ deg.

method.value: arctan rotation curve, oblate spheroid of axis ratio 0.2, coupled inclination, 11 free parameters

evidence.quote: This modelling has eleven free parameters

assumptions.value: ionised and molecular gas co-planar; PAs free

evidence.quote: we are assuming that the ionized and molecular gas ISM phases are co-planar

fitting.value: genetic algorithm; total chi2 summed over 2D maps

evidence.quote: a genetic algorithm (cite: Charbonneau1995) is used to find the best-fit model

method.value: subtract velocity gradients across beam from dispersion map (Stott+16 Eq. A1); sigma is median beyond central zone of 3x resolution

evidence.quote: We subtract them linearly from the corresponding velocity dispersion map by following Eq. A1 from (cite: Stott2016).

method.value: tilted-ring harmonic decomposition; k5/k1, Shapiro+08 and Bloom+18 estimators

evidence.quote: we quantify the kinematic deviations from the ideal rotating disk case by performing a ‘*kinemetry*’ analysis

Data were reduced using Common Astronomy Software Applications

evidence.quote: using the EMCEE algorithm (cite: Foreman2013)
the Bayesian SED fitting code, MAGPHYS (cite: daCunha2008)

findings_qualitative.value: SHiZELS-8 is dynamically perturbed: Halpha and CO PAs offset by ~100-120 deg.

evidence.quote: position angles offset by $\sim 100-120$ deg

claims.hypothesis: Do CO and Halpha trace the same kinematics in SHiZELS-19?
claims.experiment: Joint 2D kinematic model at matched 0.15'' resolution
claims.result: r1/2 ratio 1.07±0.09, Vrot/sigma 0.99 and 1.33, PA agree within 1 sigma
claims.finding: Both phases show similar extent, rotation and dispersion

evidence.quote: The molecular and ionized gas components show similar scale sizes $r_{\rm 1/2,H\alpha} / r_{\rm 1/2,CO} \approx 1.07 \pm 0.09$.

claims.hypothesis: Does SHiZELS-19 have a non-negligible dark matter fraction?
claims.experiment: Thick-disk dynamical mass plus MCMC with alpha_CO of Narayanan+12
claims.finding: Non-negligible dark matter; consistent with Tiley+18

evidence.quote: finding a dark matter fraction of $f_{\rm DM} = 0.59\pm0.10$ within this aperture

claims.hypothesis: Does a typical z~1.5 galaxy follow the local star formation law?
claims.experiment: kpc-scale Sigma_SFR vs Sigma_H2 and depletion time
claims.finding: Consistent with local law at denser ISM

evidence.quote: This median value is consistent with the typical value observed in local galaxies at similar spatial scales

why_this_method.value: Narayanan+12 alpha_CO adopted since it includes gas density effects

evidence.quote: we use the (cite: Narayanan2012)’s parametrization as it does consider the ISM density effect in the estimation of $\alpha_{\rm CO}$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Thin-disk dynamical mass rejected (implies no gas); morphological quenching considered unlikely

evidence.quote: this ‘thin disk’ dynamical mass value would suggest that this galaxy has almost no gaseous mass content

limitations_admitted.value: Conclusions highly dependent on the assumed alpha_CO

evidence.quote: our conclusions are highly dependent on the assumed $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ value

limitations_admitted.value: SHiZELS-8 CO S/N too low for detailed dynamics

evidence.quote: Unfortunately the SHiZELS-8 CO(2-1) observations have too low S/N to allow a detailed dynamical characterization.
